title: Resolución JTNCA 006-01/2025: adopción de las Normas de Información Financiera de Sostenibilidad NIIF S1 y NIIF S2
citation: JUNTEC Resolución JTNCA 006-01/2025 of 2025-01-31, La Gaceta No. 36,828 of 2025-05-03 (Sección B)
evidence: Text layer of the JUNTEC file (a scan; the layer misreads "del 1 de enero" as "del1de enero"): "Estas normas entrarán en vigencia a partir del1de enero de 2028." SEXTO: "La presente Resolución es de ejecución inmediata y se publicará en el Diario Oficial La Gaceta." Opened https://juntec.org.hn/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/2025-01-31-Resolucion-JTNCA-006-01-2025-Adopcion-NIIF-S1-y-NIIF-S2-La-Gaceta.pdf-2025.pdf on 2026-11-03 (200, 1851050 bytes, application/pdf).
notes: Link only: the file is an Adobe Scan photograph of the La Gaceta page and its machine text layer is garbled ('Oue', 'COmo', 'CONSIDERAND0', 'SI' for S1, columns interleaved), so no faithful text can be stored and there is no OCR step. The resolution itself is of immediate execution (SEXTO); in_force is the date the adopted standards apply (first report for 2028-12-31); the resolution has no earlier commencement date on the page. Row HN-JUNTEC-ADOPTED passes (La Gaceta page shown) but nothing is stored. JUNTEC's own resolution page is https://juntec.org.hn/2025/09/01/resolucion-jtnca-006-01-2025/. title: Decreto 297-2013: Ley de Cambio Climático
citation: Decreto Legislativo No. 297-2013, Ley de Cambio Climático, La Gaceta No. 33,577 of 2014-11-10
evidence: No official page opened states the commencement clause (the TSC file is a scan). The TSC item page (opened 2026-11-03) reads "Poder Legislativo Decreto No. 297-2013 Decreta: Ley de Cambio Climático". Publication is stated by an official gazette text, Decreto 54-2023 art. 26: "Derogar el Artículo 40 del Decreto Legislativo No.297-2013 contentivo de la LEY DE CAMBIO CLIMÁTICO, publicado en fecha 10 de noviembre del año 2014, en el Diario Oficial “La Gaceta”, número 33,577."

Art. 40 was repealed by hn-carbono-forestal (art. 26), which confirms the law is in force. The existing register row pointed at climate-laws.org (not the publisher); official_source_url is replaced with the TSC page and the title is kept. title: Decreto 54-2023: Ley Especial de las Transacciones de Carbono Forestal para la Justicia Climática

evidence: Artículo 28: "El presente Decreto entrará en vigencia a partir de su publicación en el Diario Oficial “La Gaceta”." The file is the Gaceta page headed "LUNES 30 DE OCTUBRE DEL 2023. NUM. 36,370". Opened https://www.tsc.gob.hn/web/leyes/Decreto-54-2023.pdf on 2026-11-03.
notes: The carbon-market instrument the brief asked to confirm: it creates the Comisión Nacional para las Transacciones de Carbono and a registry of forest-carbon transactions. Art. 26 repeals art. 40 of the Ley de Cambio Climático (hn-ley-cambio-climatico) and art. 27 repeals numeral 15 of art. 3 of the Ley Forestal. The record is the 16-page Gaceta file read column by column (left column then right, per page); the masthead, summary box, page numbers and the Empresa Nacional de Artes Gráficas address box and signature block are left out. Languages stored on 2026-11-03: es.
